lines.q: Twenty Premier League questions. Only real fans get them all. Who is the Premier League's all-time top scorer?
lines.a: Alan Shearer! Two hundred and sixty goals.

lines.q: Which club went a whole Premier League season unbeaten?
lines.a: Arsenal! The Invincibles of oh-three, oh-four.

lines.q: Who won the title in twenty sixteen at five thousand to one odds?
lines.a: Leicester City! The greatest miracle ever.

lines.q: Which club has won the most Premier League titles?
lines.a: Manchester United! Thirteen titles.

lines.q: Who scored the famous title winner at ninety-three twenty in twenty twelve?
lines.a: Sergio Agüero! Agueroooo!

lines.q: What's the record for goals by one player in a single Premier League season?
lines.a: Thirty-six! Erling Haaland.

lines.q: Which team set the record of one hundred points?
lines.a: Manchester City! Back in twenty eighteen.

lines.q: Which manager won the most Premier League titles?
lines.a: Sir Alex Ferguson! Thirteen titles.

lines.q: Who won the Premier League in nineteen ninety-five?
lines.a: Blackburn Rovers!

lines.q: Which goalkeeper has the most Premier League clean sheets?
lines.a: Petr Čech! Over two hundred. If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: Who has the most Premier League assists ever?
lines.a: Ryan Giggs! A hundred and sixty-two.

lines.q: Which club got just eleven points in one season?
lines.a: Derby County! Back in two thousand eight.

lines.q: Who scored the fastest goal in Premier League history?
lines.a: Shane Long! After just seven seconds.

lines.q: How many Premier League titles in a row did Man City win?
lines.a: Four! From twenty twenty-one to twenty twenty-four.

lines.q: Who has the most Premier League appearances?
lines.a: James Milner! He passed Gareth Barry in twenty twenty-six.

lines.q: Who scored the first ever Premier League goal?
lines.a: Brian Deane! For Sheffield United.

lines.q: Who scored the fastest Premier League hat-trick?
lines.a: Sadio Mané! In under three minutes.

lines.q: What's the biggest winning margin in a Premier League game?
lines.a: Nine goals! Nine nil, the record scoreline.

lines.q: Who finished second in the twenty twenty-five, twenty-six Golden Boot race?
lines.a: Igor Thiago! Behind Haaland.

lines.q: Last one. Who won the twenty twenty-five, twenty-six Premier League?
lines.a: Arsenal! Their first title in twenty-two years.

outroLine: How many did you get? Comment your score below, and subscribe with the bell on for a new quiz every day!
